frequency_question: How often does the central bank implement an incremental cash reserve ratio or equivalent specialized liquidity absorption tool when excess liquidity pressures build up?
membership_rule: Includes any formal deployment of incremental cash reserve ratios (iCRR) or analogous targeted reserve mandates by the central bank. Excludes standard adjustments to the main headline cash reserve ratio or repo rates.

cases.name: RBI ad-hoc CRR/incremental absorption measures during prior liquidity surges

provenance_note: 2 cases named, 4 claimed via skeleton x multiplier (2.0x)
coverage_note: 2 named major instances of incremental reserve ratio tools deployed to manage sudden liquidity spikes.
known_gaps: Minor technical variations in wording or minor standing facility adjustments might not be fully captured as formal iCRR events.
skeleton: Central bank liquidity management episodes requiring targeted tightening tools over the last two decades.
multiplier: 2 hits observed out of roughly 4 major systemic excess liquidity surges requiring non-standard reserve measures in the period.
validity_reason: Central bank institutional frameworks and liquidity management toolkits evolve slowly over multi-decade horizons.
